backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor for the Somers Scheduler backend, implementing user profiles, win/loss stats, leaderboard, availability scheduling, chat posts, reactions, daily logs, and badge definitions/awards with role-based access control and blob storage mixins.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting a single high-confidence fix to the ProfileWinLossChart component so that x-axis dates are derived from real match history data anchored to the current date.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Auto-generated JSON summary catalog describing the purpose and key details of each frontend source file in the project.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind CSS entry point defining CSS custom property design tokens for light and dark themes including colors, radius, chart palette, and sidebar variables.
frontend/index.html: HTML shell for the React SPA with PWA manifest, favicon, iOS home screen and splash screen meta tags, and a root div that mounts the Vite/React app.
frontend/public/manifest.webmanifest: PWA web app manifest for Somers Scheduler defining app name, display mode, theme colors, and icon URLs for 192×192 and 512×512 sizes.
frontend/public/offline.html: Static offline fallback page shown by the service worker when the user has no network connection, with a styled 'You're Offline' message and a retry button.
frontend/public/sw.js: Service worker implementing precaching of core assets on install, old-cache cleanup on activate, and a network-first fetch strategy with offline fallback for navigation and cache-first for static assets, skipping IC/identity network traffic.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root application component that sets up routing with TanStack Router and an AuthGate wrapper handling Internet Identity authentication, actor initialization, profile loading, and leaderboard setup.
frontend/src/components/admin/BadgeManag: Admin UI component for creating, editing, and deleting badge definitions with criteria types (totalWins, winsStreak, totalGames) and a threshold value.
frontend/src/components/auth/AccessDenie: Simple full-page card component displayed when a non-admin user attempts to access a restricted admin page, with a link back to the calendar.
frontend/src/components/auth/LoginScreen: Login page with a background image and card UI that triggers Internet Identity authentication via a sign-in button.
frontend/src/components/branding/AppLogo: Small presentational component that renders the application logo image using branding configuration constants.
frontend/src/components/chat/ChatPanel.t: Main chat UI component that displays a threaded post list, handles new message submission with optional image attachments, and shows upload progress.
frontend/src/components/chat/DeleteMessa: Confirmation alert dialog component for permanently deleting a chat message, with loading state support.
frontend/src/components/chat/ImageAttach: File picker component for attaching images to chat messages, with preview display, validation, and clear functionality.
frontend/src/components/chat/ReactionCon: Like/dislike reaction buttons for chat posts with optimistic UI updates and rollback on error.
frontend/src/components/chat/ReplyCompos: A form component for composing and submitting replies to a parent post, supporting text input and optional image attachments with upload progress tracking.
frontend/src/components/chat/ThreadedPos: Renders a recursive threaded tree of posts with support for inline editing, deletion, reactions, and reply composition, indenting nested replies visually.
frontend/src/components/common/ErrorStat: A reusable error alert component that displays a title, message, and optional retry or secondary action buttons.
frontend/src/components/common/LoadingSt: Provides two loading spinner components: a full-page centered loader and a smaller inline loader with configurable size and message.
frontend/src/components/layout/AppLayout: Top-level layout wrapper that composes the offline banner, top bar, navigation, main content area, and footer with a caffeine.ai attribution link.
frontend/src/components/layout/Navigatio: Horizontal navigation bar with links to Calendar, Leaderboard, Profile, and conditionally Admin (for admin users), highlighting the active route.
frontend/src/components/layout/PageLayou: Utility layout components: `Page` constrains content to a configurable max width, and `PageHeader` renders a title with an optional icon and action slot.
frontend/src/components/layout/TopBar.ts: App header displaying the logo, app name, theme toggle, PWA install button, and a user avatar dropdown menu with logout functionality.
frontend/src/components/profile/ProfileB: Displays a grid of earned achievement badges for a given user principal, fetching badge definitions and user awards, with loading skeletons and an empty state.
frontend/src/components/profile/ProfileC: Displays and edits the current user's profile card, supporting inline name editing and avatar image upload with progress tracking via the backend actor.
frontend/src/components/profile/ProfileL: Shows the current user's all-time leaderboard rank by finding their principal in the leaderboard data.
frontend/src/components/profile/ProfileM: Renders a paginated list of the caller's match history entries showing wins and losses per day, with loading and error states.
frontend/src/components/profile/ProfileS: Modal dialog that prompts new users to enter their name on first login, saving it via the profile mutation hook.
frontend/src/components/profile/ProfileW: Renders a filterable line chart of the user's wins and losses over selectable time ranges (week, month, year, all-time) using Recharts.
frontend/src/components/pwa/InstallInstr: Dialog that provides step-by-step instructions for installing the app as a PWA, with separate flows for iOS and Android/other browsers.
frontend/src/components/pwa/OfflineBanne: Fixed top banner that listens to browser online/offline events and displays a warning when the user loses network connectivity.
frontend/src/components/theme/Background: Wrapper component that renders a fixed, dimmed court image as a full-screen background behind its children.
Reusable component that displays a user's avatar (with image or initials fallback) alongside their display name, supporting multiple sizes.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: React hook that creates and caches an authenticated or anonymous backend actor using the current Internet Identity, invalidating dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useCurrentUserProfile: Provides hooks for fetching and saving the caller's user profile via the backend actor, with query invalidation on save.
frontend/src/hooks/useCurrentUserRole.ts: Provides hooks to query the caller's user role and admin status from the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides a React context and hook for Internet Identity authentication, including login, logout, and identity persistence via AuthClient.
frontend/src/hooks/usePWAInstallPrompt.t: Hook that manages PWA install prompt state, detecting iOS, standalone mode, and exposing a function to trigger the browser's install prompt.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Collection of React Query hooks wrapping backend actor calls for user profiles, availability, leaderboard, posts, and other app data.
frontend/src/hooks/useTheme.ts: Hook that manages light/dark theme state, persisting the preference to localStorage and toggling the 'dark' class on the document root.
frontend/src/hooks/useUserDirectory.ts: React Query hooks for fetching display names and avatars for a list of principals, with fallback to truncated principal strings.
frontend/src/index.css: Global CSS file defining Tailwind base styles, CSS custom properties for light/dark themes, and safe-area/layout utilities for PWA support.
frontend/src/lib/branding.ts: Exports a centralized BRANDING constant object containing the app name, logo URL, and logo alt text.
frontend/src/lib/chatThreads.ts: Utilities for building a nested thread tree from a flat list of posts and flattening it with depth metadata for rendering.
frontend/src/lib/date.ts: Date utility functions for converting between Date objects and numeric day IDs, generating calendar grids, and formatting dates and timestamps.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that mounts the React app wrapped with QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider.
frontend/src/pages/AddAvailabilityPage.t: A form page that allows users to add or edit their availability for a specific date, with time (hour/minute/AM-PM) and notes fields, navigating back to the day detail view on success.
frontend/src/pages/AdminPage.tsx: An admin-only page that displays and manages registered users, their availabilities, and login timestamps, with delete actions and a badge management section.
frontend/src/pages/CalendarMonthPage.tsx: A monthly calendar view that shows per-day availability counts as clickable cells linking to day detail pages, with month navigation and an embedded chat panel.
frontend/src/pages/ChatPage.tsx: A simple page that renders the full-height group chat panel with a header icon and title.
frontend/src/pages/DayDetailPage.tsx: A detail page for a specific date that lists all users marked available with their times and notes, and allows the current user to edit or delete their own availability entry.
frontend/src/pages/LeaderboardPage.tsx: A leaderboard page displaying ranked users by wins/losses, allowing the current user to record or remove wins and losses for their available days, with rank-change toast notifications.
frontend/src/pages/ProfilePage.tsx: Renders the user profile page with sections for profile card, leaderboard ranking, win/loss streaks, win/loss chart, match history, and badges, fetching data via custom hooks.
frontend/src/utils/file.ts: Provides utility functions for converting files to Uint8Array, extracting name initials, and validating image file type and size.
frontend/src/utils/time.ts: Provides utility functions for generating time option lists (hours, minutes, periods) and parsing/formatting 12-hour time strings into structured components.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Provides utilities for reading URL parameters from both query strings and hash-based routing, with sessionStorage persistence and cleanup helpers.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration with dark mode, custom OKLCH-based color tokens, border radius, accordion animations, and plugins for typography, container queries, and animate.
project_state.json: Tracks project state and feature requests, currently flagging a known issue where the ProfileWinLossChart x-axis shows incorrect programmatically-generated dates instead of actual match history dates.
